extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from reopened XML/PDF/figure locators; direct mechanism claims require explicit assay types and non-mechanistic efficacy context remains separated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: STIP3-29 and D-STIP3-29 rapidly altered MRSA ATCC 33592 membrane integrity in SYTOX Green and DiSC3(5) assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assays support membrane permeabilization/depolarization behavior but do not define a receptor-specific molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FAM-labeled STIP3-29 variants accumulated inside MRSA cells, and TEM separated rapid cell penetration from later lysis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cell penetration and delayed lysis are source-supported phenotypes; exact intracellular target is not resolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: STIP3-29 controlled MRSA expansion in a three-dimensional epidermal skin infection model at the tested treatment concentration.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is efficacy/context evidence and is not promoted to a molecular mechanism.
